scenarios.prompt: Inspect sql/report.sql together with schema/. Determine which physical columns contribute to the output column gross_amount. Distinguish proven lineage from unresolved ownership and do not claim anything about live data.

files.content: create table public.orders (id bigint primary key, discount numeric not null);
create table public.order_items (id bigint primary key, order_id bigint not null, quantity integer not null, unit_price numeric not null);

with item_totals as (
  select order_id, sum(quantity * unit_price) as subtotal
  from public.order_items
  group by order_id
)
select o.id, i.subtotal + o.discount as gross_amount
from public.orders o
join item_totals i on i.order_id = o.id;

scenarios.prompt: Explain sql/late_customers.sql and provide a standalone executable SQL form of the derived table named paid_orders only if its query boundary is statically safe. If the boundary is not proven, stop instead of guessing.

Prepare a static extraction plan for reproducing the customer-specific result of sql/customer_orders.sql using schema/. I need bounded SELECT statements and dependency/load order, not database execution. Report if a safe boundary cannot be proven.

files.content: create table public.orders (id bigint primary key, customer_id bigint not null);
create table public.order_items (id bigint primary key, order_id bigint not null references public.orders(id), amount numeric not null);

select o.id, sum(i.amount) as total_amount
from public.orders o
join public.order_items i on i.order_id = o.id
where o.customer_id = :customer_id
group by o.id;
